reserveReview.rationale: OpenEden's issuer-operated reserve API snapshot at 2026-07-22T08:00:19.092Z reported $28,760,245.354108024 in reserve assets against 28,431,286.133951165 USDO, a 101.157% reserve ratio. The API constituent values normalize to the rounded full-composition weights recorded here: OpenEden TBILL 79.18%, BUIDL 9.40%, RLUSD 8.24%, VBILL 2.97%, and USDC 0.21%. Zero-balance USYC, BENJI, and pending-USDC fields do not create slices. 2026-07-30 addendum (Kimi T53 dependency review): the machine-readable coinId link from the TBILL slice to tbill-openeden was removed because tbill-openeden is quarantined (listingStatusReview changedAt 2026-07-15, reviewBy 2026-08-15, withheld for missing runtime supply/market-cap sources) and therefore outside the report-card active set, which left the compiled dependency graph invalid with issue outside-active-set:tbill-openeden. The slice's economic description (79.18% OpenEden TBILL, tokenized U.S. T-bills) is unchanged; restore the coinId link if tbill-openeden re-enters the active set.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: OpenEden states that USDO reserve assets and liabilities are held in a segregated account of a Bermuda segregated-accounts company and are insulated from claims against other accounts. The current reserve API identifies asset holdings but not the account-level custodians, provider shares, underlying fund custody chains, or rehypothecation terms.
